title: A bot can read the other channels it belongs to
description: Tools for a bot to list, read and search the channels it participates in, and nothing else. This is how the newsroom bot sees every Story conversation while each stays a separate session. Settle the open question in docs/ORGANIZATIONS.md: a newsroom has no restricted channels, so reading across is intended, but the rule must hold where a bot is in both a restricted channel and an open one. Done: Gherkin scenarios for reading a joined channel, refusal on a channel it has not joined, and search across channels; ORGANIZATIONS.md updated. Depends on the shared channel task.
